skill.summary: Text-to-speech using Kokoro local TTS. Use when the user wants to convert text to audio, read aloud, or generate speech.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with major changes and focus shift:

- Replaces prior auto-adaptive TTS configuration with a practical guide for using Kokoro local TTS.
- Added detailed usage examples, quick start commands, and installation instructions.
- Voices table gives an at-a-glance overview of available options.
- Removed adaptive preference tracking and configuration details (config.md, criteria.md).
